Security Solutions for Central Florida

Every business faces different security challenges. Our officers are trained to adapt to your environment, protecting your customers, employees, property, and assets with professionalism and vigilance.

Event Security

Residential Security

Who it's for: private estates, gated communities, and homeowners associations. Patrol and access control that let you feel at ease at home.

Commercial Security

Commercial Security

Who it's for: Retail stores, shopping centers, commercial properties, office buildings, corporate facilities, and property managers. Warehouse Security

Who it's for: warehouses, distribution centers, and industrial parks. Perimeter checks, access monitoring, and dependable overnight coverage.

Construction Site Security

Emergency & Disaster Response
